name: Jeff Jaramillo
source:
Jeff Jaramillo is [url=https://vndb.org/c167526]Jujen[/url]'s older cousin. He owns and runs his own auto-mechanical business to some moderate levels of success. He's likely the closest to Jujen out of all his family given he sponsored her parole and now employees her. Unlike Jujen, however, he clearly comes from a Hispanic family as opposed to a Marshallese one.

[In game description]
